CallSite.sol.content: pragma solidity 0.8.25; interface IWithdrawalVault { function addConsolidationRequests(bytes[] calldata sourcePubkeys, bytes[] calldata targetPubkeys) external payable; } contract CallSite { function execute(IWithdrawalVault withdrawalVault, bytes[] memory sourcePubkeys, bytes[] memory targetPubkeys, uint256 totalFee) external { withdrawalVault.addConsolidationRequests{value: totalFee}(sourcePubkeys, targetPubkeys); } }
